local-disposable-fixture.description: In-process fixture state only; no host or sandbox lifecycle access

fixture_collector_restart.hypothesis: Collector continuity evidence identifies a bounded restart and recovery.
fixture_collector_restart.steady_state: Fixture collector is running and its queue is empty.
fixture_collector_restart.rollback: Restore the fixture collector running state.

fixture_exporter_outage.hypothesis: A brief exporter outage is visible and buffered fixture evidence recovers.
fixture_exporter_outage.steady_state: Fixture exporter is available and its buffer is empty.
fixture_exporter_outage.rollback: Restore fixture exporter availability and drain the fixture buffer.

fixture_backpressure.hypothesis: Fixture backpressure remains bounded and clears without loss.
fixture_backpressure.steady_state: Fixture queue depth is zero and accepts bounded metadata.
fixture_backpressure.rollback: Release fixture pressure and clear the fixture queue.

fixture_authorization_rejection.hypothesis: An unauthorized fixture request is rejected and audited without state change.
fixture_authorization_rejection.steady_state: Fixture authorization policy permits only the designated identity.
fixture_authorization_rejection.rollback: Restore the fixture identity and verify no protected state changed.

fixture_evidence_corruption.hypothesis: Mutation of a copied fixture record is detected without touching the live ledger.
fixture_evidence_corruption.steady_state: The copied fixture record verifies and the live ledger is read-only.
fixture_evidence_corruption.rollback: Discard the mutated copy and re-verify the original fixture digest.
